spec.title: Every glider kit truck listed for sale in the US

items.label: Scope
items.value: Every glider kit truck currently listed for sale in the US, any make, model or engine. Not tied to a co-host spec: this tab is an inventory sweep, not a spec match.

items.label: What counts as a glider
items.value: A new chassis/cab built as a glider kit (factory or Fitzgerald/Harrison-type) with a rebuilt or pre-emission engine. Proof: the listing says glider/glider kit, or the VIN carries the glider code (Peterbilt/Kenworth "GGGG" e.g. 1NPXGGGG/1NKWGGGG, Freightliner 3ALX..., Western Star 5KKXA...).

items.label: Match badge
items.value: exact = glider confirmed by the listing or VIN. close = very likely a glider (pre-emission engine in a late-model truck) but the listing does not say glider and the VIN is a standard factory VIN.

items.label: Makes / models seen
items.value: Peterbilt 389/388/579, Kenworth W900/T800/T660, Freightliner Coronado/Columbia/Cascadia, Western Star 4900.

items.label: Engine miles since rebuild
items.value: engine_miles_since_rebuild is filled only when the listing states miles on the overhaul/reman (or gives odometer at overhaul). Date-only rebuild notes are kept in misses; the field stays null.

items.label: Sources
items.value: Soarr (7E Sales, Don Van Orden), Truck Market, Forge Truck Centers, Ohio Truck Sales, I-294 Used Truck Sales, 5 Star Truck Sales, Truck Center Companies, TruckPaper listing pages, BisManOnline. Every link loaded and was not marked sold/pending/reserved on Oct 22, 2026. No seller was contacted.
